title: History and the Politics of American Memory
description: In this course students will study the relationship between history, memory, politics, and 20th Century American warfare. Examining multiple forms used to convey historical information - includingphotography, film, memorials/museums, monuments, children's literature, memoirs, television and digital sites- students will consider how "collective memory-making" has intersected with the changing and contested histories of 20th century American wars.
